results.title: Send As Alias :: Add-ons for Thunderbird
results.snippet: • Reply as Alias now also detects your alias from mail delivery headers (X-Original-To, Delivered-To, Envelope-To), so replies use the right alias even when it doesn't appear in To/CC — e.g. for BCC'd mail or mailing lists.

results.title: GitHub - mkoester/thunderbird_send_as · GitHub
results.snippet: Open extension settings (Tools → Add-ons → Send As Alias → Preferences) ... Reply as Alias is the per-account master switch: no feature works for an account without it (Alias Suggestion additionally has its own checkbox)
